title: ABF 增層封裝基板
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入ABF 介電增層、微孔、銅附著與高頻損耗；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine abf build-up dielectric, microvias, copper adhesion and rf loss. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。ABF 是材料系列商標，不是一種固定通用配方；固化、粗化及製程條件需依供應商版本與專業設備規範。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. ABF is a branded material family, not one universal recipe; cure, roughening and process conditions require vendor-version and equipment specifications.

Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
